description: This Java class implements a command handler for activating email campaigns within the Fineract platform. It processes activation commands and delegates the activation operation to the EmailCampaignWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ActivateEmailCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class marked with @CommandType to handle activation of email campaigns. Implements NewCommandSourceHandler and processes commands by invoking the email campaign service.

methods.name: ActivateEmailCampaignCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the EmailCampaignWritePlatformService via dependency injection.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand to activate an email campaign by delegating to emailCampaignWritePlatformService.activateEmailCampaign.
